content.text: {"core": "Plurality holds many cognitions at once without collapsing them to one. In Wisdom, it operates on the still interior where knowing settles: it multiplies the voices reading the same silence. Unacknowledged, the multiplication runs unregistered, so competing readings are taken for a single deep certainty, and the crowd inside speaks with one borrowed authority.", "sheetLine": "Many voices are reading the quiet at once, each sure it is the only one."}
